purpose: Evaluate the BSM simple chooser model against a simulated stochastic-volatility reference benchmark. This is not actual OTC transaction data.
disclosure: The Heston Monte Carlo price is a synthetic reference benchmark rather than a market transaction price.
The benchmark is used to test the impact of stochastic volatility on the constant-volatility BSM chooser model.
MAE and RMSE measure divergence from the simulated benchmark, not real-market pricing error.
